hawaii.title: Hawaiʻi
hawaii.description: Ka Pae ʻĀina ʻo Hawaiʻi — Honolulu, Hilo, Kahului; Oʻahu, Maui, Hawaiʻi (ka Mokupuni Nui), Kauaʻi, Molokaʻi a me Lānaʻi; Mauna Kea, Mauna Loa, Haleakalā, Puʻuloa (Pearl Harbor) a me ke kahakai ʻo Nā Pali.

south-central-us.title: Ka Hema Waena o ʻAmelika Hui Pū ʻIa
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi a me Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson a me Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Kāmoa a me Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Kāmoa, Kāmoa ʻAmelika, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, a me Wallis a me Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi a me Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila a me nā mokupuni o Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam a me Nā Mokupuni ʻĀkau o Mariana
mariana-islands.description: Guam a me Nā Mokupuni ʻĀkau o Mariana — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian a me Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq a me Tasiilaq; ka papa hau nui, ke kaikuono hau o Ilulissat a me nā fjord o ka hema.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s a me ka Royal Naval Dockyard, nā ʻāpana o ka mokupuni a me kona mau kahakai one ʻākala.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno a me Brest; ka nahele ʻo Belovezhskaya Pushcha a me nā ʻāina kele o Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Nā Mokupuni Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark a me Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port a me Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Nā Mokupuni Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Nā Mokupuni Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík a me nā mokupuni he ʻumikūmāwalu, ko lākou mau kauhale, nā ana alanui a me nā pali kahakai.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard a me Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg a me Ny-Ålesund; nā muliwai hau a me nā fjord o Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo a me Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria a me nā Kūlanakauhale ʻEkolu.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar a me Nā Mokupuni o ka Moana ʻInikia
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius a me Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis a me Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid a me Nyala; ka hui ʻana o ka Nile Uliuli a me ka Nile Keʻokeʻo a me nā pelamika o Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria a me nā mokupuni he ʻumi, mai Santo Antão a hiki i Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé a me Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé a me Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António a me nā nahele ua a me nā kahakai o nā mokupuni ʻelua.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension a me Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, ka Mokupuni ʻo Ascension a me Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown a me Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet a me Cox’s Bazar; ka Sundarbans a me ka delta o Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka a me Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka a me Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura a me Malé; ka ʻāina puʻu, Sigiriya a me nā ʻākoʻakoʻa.

vietnam.title: Wiekanama
vietnam.description: Wiekanama — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An a me Can Tho; ke kai kūono ʻo Ha Long a me ka delta o Mekong.

philippines.title: ʻĀina Pilipino
philippines.description: ʻĀina Pilipino — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio a me Zamboanga; Luzon, nā Visayas, Mindanao a me Palawan.

indonesia.title: ʻInikonekia a me Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: ʻInikonekia a me Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar a me Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi a me Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore a me Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore a me Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching a me Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine a me ka loko ʻo Inle; ke awāwa o Irrawaddy a me nā puʻu o Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Cambodia a me Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Cambodia a me Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap a me Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang a me Pakse; ka muliwai ʻo Mekong a me ka Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolomepia
colombia.description: Kolomepia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena a me Bucaramanga; nā Andes, ke kahakai Karipiano a me ka Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida a me Ciudad Bolívar; ka wailele ʻo Angel, ka Orinoco a me Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos a me Puno; Machu Picchu, ka loko ʻo Titicaca a me ke Awāwa Laʻa.

ecuador.title: ʻEkuakoa
ecuador.description: ʻEkuakoa — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta a me Baños; ke Alanui o nā Lua Pele, ka Amazon a me nā Mokupuni Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre a me Potosí; ka loko ʻo Titicaca a me ka Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Kile
chile.description: Kile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena a me Punta Arenas; ka Atacama, ka ʻāina loko, Patagonia a me Rapa Nui.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay a me Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay a me Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este a me Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Nā Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname a me Guiana Palani — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne a me Kourou; ka wailele ʻo Kaieteur a me ka nahele ua o ka Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Nā Mokupuni Falkland
falklands.description: Nā Mokupuni Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green a me nā mokupuni ʻo East Falkland a me West Falkland.

australia.title: Nūhōlani
australia.description: Nūhōlani — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin a me Canberra; ka Great Barrier Reef, Uluru a me ka Outback.

new-zealand.title: Aotearoa
new-zealand.description: Aotearoa — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin a me Queenstown; nā Southern Alps, Fiordland a me Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George a me Whistler; nā Coast Mountains, ka Mokupuni ʻo Vancouver a me ka Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Nā Kula Pāpū o Kanakā
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan a me Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina a me Banff; nā Rockies, nā kula pāpū a me Churchill ma Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston a me Thunder Bay; ka wailele ʻo Niagara, nā Loko Nui a me Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke a me Saguenay; ka muliwai ʻo St. Lawrence, nā Laurentians a me ka Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Kanakā ʻAkelanika
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, a me Newfoundland a me Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton a me Charlottetown; ka Cabot Trail a me ke kai kūono ʻo Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Kanakā ʻĀkau
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories a me Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City a me Inuvik; ka pae mokupuni ʻAkika a me ka muliwai ʻo Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong a me Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong a me Macau — ka Mokupuni ʻo Hong Kong, Kowloon, nā New Territories, Lantau a me ka Macau Peninsula, Taipa a me Coloane.
